SELECT NestedSelect.Ref AS Ref, NestedSelect.Date AS Date, NestedSelect.DeletionMark AS DeletionMark, NestedSelect.Number AS Number, NestedSelect.Posted AS Posted, NestedSelect.Customer AS Customer, NestedSelect.Contract AS Contract, NestedSelect.GuestGroup AS GuestGroup, NestedSelect.Sum AS Sum, NestedSelect.CommissionSum AS CommissionSum, NestedSelect.Payment AS Payment, NestedSelect.Currency AS Currency, NestedSelect.PaymentMethod AS PaymentMethod, NestedSelect.CashRegister AS CashRegister, NestedSelect.ParentDoc AS ParentDoc, NestedSelect.InvoiceNumber AS InvoiceNumber, NestedSelect.Remarks AS Remarks, NestedSelect.Hotel AS Hotel, NestedSelect.Company AS Company, NestedSelect.Author AS Author, NestedSelect.ExternalCode AS ExternalCode, NestedSelect.AccountingSum AS AccountingSum, NestedSelect.IsChecked AS IsChecked, NestedSelect.CustomerPaymentAuthor AS CustomerPaymentAuthor, NestedSelect.CloseOfPeriod AS CloseOfPeriod, NestedSelect.Service AS Service, NestedSelect.Folio AS Folio, NestedSelect.Type AS Type, CASE WHEN NestedSelect.Posted THEN CASE WHEN ISNULL(NestedSelect.Sum, 0) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN ISNULL(NestedSelect.Sum, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(NestedSelect.Sum, 0) - ISNULL(InvoiceAccountsBalance.SumBalance, 0) >= NestedSelect.Sum THEN 5 WHEN ISNULL(NestedSelect.Sum, 0) < 0 AND ISNULL(NestedSelect.Sum, 0) - ISNULL(InvoiceAccountsBalance.SumBalance, 0) <= NestedSelect.Sum THEN 5 ELSE CASE WHEN ISNULL(NestedSelect.Sum, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(NestedSelect.Sum, 0) - ISNULL(InvoiceAccountsBalance.SumBalance, 0) > 0 THEN 3 WHEN ISNULL(NestedSelect.Sum, 0) < 0 AND ISNULL(NestedSelect.Sum, 0) - ISNULL(InvoiceAccountsBalance.SumBalance, 0) < 0 THEN 3 ELSE 1 END END ELSE 0 END AS IDStatus FROM (SELECT DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.Ref AS Ref, DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.Date AS Date, DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.DeletionMark AS DeletionMark, DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.Number AS Number, DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.Posted AS Posted, DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.Customer AS Customer, DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.Contract AS Contract, DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.GuestGroup AS GuestGroup, DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.Sum AS Sum, DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.CommissionSum AS CommissionSum, DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.Payment AS Payment, DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.Currency AS Currency, DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.PaymentMethod AS PaymentMethod, DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.CashRegister AS CashRegister, DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.ParentDoc AS ParentDoc, DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.InvoiceNumber AS InvoiceNumber, CAST(DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.Remarks AS STRING(150)) AS Remarks, DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.Hotel AS Hotel, DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.Company AS Company, DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.Author AS Author, DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.ExternalCode AS ExternalCode, DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.AccountingSum AS AccountingSum, DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.IsChecked AS IsChecked, DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.CustomerPaymentAuthor AS CustomerPaymentAuthor, DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.CloseOfPeriod AS CloseOfPeriod, NULL AS Service, DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.Ref.Folio AS Folio, DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.Type AS Type FROM DocumentJournal.CustomerAccountsJournal AS DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal WHERE NOT &qServiceIsSelected AND (DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.Hotel IN HIERARCHY (&qHotel) OR &qHotel = VALUE(Catalog.Hotels.EmptyRef)) AND (DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.Company IN HIERARCHY (&qCompany) OR &qCompany = VALUE(Catalog.Companies.EmptyRef)) AND (NOT &qFolioIsSelected OR &qFolioIsSelected AND NOT DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.Ref REFS Document.Settlement AND NOT DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.Ref REFS Document.CreditNote AND NOT DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.Ref REFS Document.DebitNote) AND (NOT &qPeriodIsFilled OR &qPeriodIsFilled AND DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.Date >= &qPeriodFrom AND DocumentJournalCustomerAccountsJournal.Date <= &qPeriodTo)
UNION ALL
SELECT DataFromInvoiceServices.Ref, DataFromInvoiceServices.Date, DataFromInvoiceServices.DeletionMark, DataFromInvoiceServices.Number, DataFromInvoiceServices.Posted, DataFromInvoiceServices.Customer, DataFromInvoiceServices.Contract, CASE WHEN &qGuestGroupIsSelected THEN InvoiceServices.GuestGroup ELSE InvoiceServices.Ref.GuestGroup END, DataFromInvoiceServices.Sum, DataFromInvoiceServices.CommissionSum, DataFromInvoiceServices.Payment, DataFromInvoiceServices.Currency, DataFromInvoiceServices.PaymentMethod, DataFromInvoiceServices.CashRegister, DataFromInvoiceServices.ParentDoc, DataFromInvoiceServices.InvoiceNumber, CAST(DataFromInvoiceServices.Remarks AS STRING(150)), DataFromInvoiceServices.Hotel, DataFromInvoiceServices.Company, DataFromInvoiceServices.Author, DataFromInvoiceServices.ExternalCode, DataFromInvoiceServices.AccountingSum, DataFromInvoiceServices.IsChecked, DataFromInvoiceServices.CustomerPaymentAuthor, DataFromInvoiceServices.CloseOfPeriod, CASE WHEN &qServiceIsSelected THEN InvoiceServices.Service ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN &qFolioIsSelected THEN InvoiceServices.Folio ELSE NULL END, DataFromInvoiceServices.Type FROM DocumentJournal.CustomerAccountsJournal AS DataFromInvoiceServices LEFT JOIN Document.Settlement.Services AS InvoiceServices ON DataFromInvoiceServices.Ref = InvoiceServices.Ref AND (&qGuestGroupIsSelected OR &qFolioIsSelected OR &qServiceIsSelected) WHERE DataFromInvoiceServices.Ref REFS Document.Settlement AND (DataFromInvoiceServices.Hotel IN HIERARCHY (&qHotel) OR &qHotel = VALUE(Catalog.Hotels.EmptyRef)) AND (DataFromInvoiceServices.Company IN HIERARCHY (&qCompany) OR &qCompany = VALUE(Catalog.Companies.EmptyRef)) AND (&qGuestGroupIsSelected OR &qFolioIsSelected OR &qServiceIsSelected) AND (NOT &qPeriodIsFilled OR &qPeriodIsFilled AND DataFromInvoiceServices.Date >= &qPeriodFrom AND DataFromInvoiceServices.Date <= &qPeriodTo)
UNION ALL
SELECT DataFromCreditNoteServices.Ref, DataFromCreditNoteServices.Date, DataFromCreditNoteServices.DeletionMark, DataFromCreditNoteServices.Number, DataFromCreditNoteServices.Posted, DataFromCreditNoteServices.Customer, DataFromCreditNoteServices.Contract, CASE WHEN &qGuestGroupIsSelected THEN CreditNoteServices.GuestGroup ELSE CreditNoteServices.Ref.GuestGroup END, DataFromCreditNoteServices.Sum, DataFromCreditNoteServices.CommissionSum, DataFromCreditNoteServices.Payment, DataFromCreditNoteServices.Currency, DataFromCreditNoteServices.PaymentMethod, DataFromCreditNoteServices.CashRegister, DataFromCreditNoteServices.ParentDoc, DataFromCreditNoteServices.InvoiceNumber, CAST(DataFromCreditNoteServices.Remarks AS STRING(150)), DataFromCreditNoteServices.Hotel, DataFromCreditNoteServices.Company, DataFromCreditNoteServices.Author, DataFromCreditNoteServices.ExternalCode, DataFromCreditNoteServices.AccountingSum, DataFromCreditNoteServices.IsChecked, DataFromCreditNoteServices.CustomerPaymentAuthor, DataFromCreditNoteServices.CloseOfPeriod, CASE WHEN &qServiceIsSelected THEN CreditNoteServices.Service ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN &qFolioIsSelected THEN CreditNoteServices.Folio ELSE NULL END, DataFromCreditNoteServices.Type FROM DocumentJournal.CustomerAccountsJournal AS DataFromCreditNoteServices LEFT JOIN Document.CreditNote.Services AS CreditNoteServices ON DataFromCreditNoteServices.Ref = CreditNoteServices.Ref AND (&qGuestGroupIsSelected OR &qFolioIsSelected OR &qServiceIsSelected) WHERE DataFromCreditNoteServices.Ref REFS Document.CreditNote AND (DataFromCreditNoteServices.Hotel IN HIERARCHY (&qHotel) OR &qHotel = VALUE(Catalog.Hotels.EmptyRef)) AND (DataFromCreditNoteServices.Company IN HIERARCHY (&qCompany) OR &qCompany = VALUE(Catalog.Companies.EmptyRef)) AND (&qGuestGroupIsSelected OR &qFolioIsSelected OR &qServiceIsSelected) AND (NOT &qPeriodIsFilled OR &qPeriodIsFilled AND DataFromCreditNoteServices.Date >= &qPeriodFrom AND DataFromCreditNoteServices.Date <= &qPeriodTo)
UNION ALL
SELECT DataFromDebitNoteServices.Ref, DataFromDebitNoteServices.Date, DataFromDebitNoteServices.DeletionMark, DataFromDebitNoteServices.Number, DataFromDebitNoteServices.Posted, DataFromDebitNoteServices.Customer, DataFromDebitNoteServices.Contract, CASE WHEN &qGuestGroupIsSelected THEN DebitNoteServices.GuestGroup ELSE DebitNoteServices.Ref.GuestGroup END, DataFromDebitNoteServices.Sum, DataFromDebitNoteServices.CommissionSum, DataFromDebitNoteServices.Payment, DataFromDebitNoteServices.Currency, DataFromDebitNoteServices.PaymentMethod, DataFromDebitNoteServices.CashRegister, DataFromDebitNoteServices.ParentDoc, DataFromDebitNoteServices.InvoiceNumber, CAST(DataFromDebitNoteServices.Remarks AS STRING(150)), DataFromDebitNoteServices.Hotel, DataFromDebitNoteServices.Company, DataFromDebitNoteServices.Author, DataFromDebitNoteServices.ExternalCode, DataFromDebitNoteServices.AccountingSum, DataFromDebitNoteServices.IsChecked, DataFromDebitNoteServices.CustomerPaymentAuthor, DataFromDebitNoteServices.CloseOfPeriod, CASE WHEN &qServiceIsSelected THEN DebitNoteServices.Service ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN &qFolioIsSelected THEN DebitNoteServices.Folio ELSE NULL END, DataFromDebitNoteServices.Type FROM DocumentJournal.CustomerAccountsJournal AS DataFromDebitNoteServices LEFT JOIN Document.DebitNote.Services AS DebitNoteServices ON DataFromDebitNoteServices.Ref = DebitNoteServices.Ref AND (&qGuestGroupIsSelected OR &qFolioIsSelected OR &qServiceIsSelected) WHERE DataFromDebitNoteServices.Ref REFS Document.DebitNote AND (DataFromDebitNoteServices.Hotel IN HIERARCHY (&qHotel) OR &qHotel = VALUE(Catalog.Hotels.EmptyRef)) AND (DataFromDebitNoteServices.Company IN HIERARCHY (&qCompany) OR &qCompany = VALUE(Catalog.Companies.EmptyRef)) AND (&qGuestGroupIsSelected OR &qFolioIsSelected OR &qServiceIsSelected) AND (NOT &qPeriodIsFilled OR &qPeriodIsFilled AND DataFromDebitNoteServices.Date >= &qPeriodFrom AND DataFromDebitNoteServices.Date <= &qPeriodTo)) AS NestedSelect LEFT JOIN AccumulationRegister.InvoiceAccounts.Balance(, ) AS InvoiceAccountsBalance ON NestedSelect.Ref = InvoiceAccountsBalance.Invoice
GROUP BY NestedSelect.Date, NestedSelect.DeletionMark, NestedSelect.Customer, NestedSelect.Posted, NestedSelect.Contract, NestedSelect.Currency, NestedSelect.PaymentMethod, NestedSelect.Number, NestedSelect.GuestGroup, NestedSelect.Ref, NestedSelect.Author, NestedSelect.CashRegister, NestedSelect.ParentDoc, NestedSelect.ExternalCode, NestedSelect.IsChecked, NestedSelect.InvoiceNumber, NestedSelect.Company, NestedSelect.Hotel, NestedSelect.CustomerPaymentAuthor, NestedSelect.AccountingSum, NestedSelect.Sum, NestedSelect.CommissionSum, NestedSelect.Payment, NestedSelect.CloseOfPeriod, NestedSelect.Remarks, NestedSelect.Service, NestedSelect.Folio, NestedSelect.Type, CASE WHEN NestedSelect.Posted THEN CASE WHEN ISNULL(NestedSelect.Sum, 0) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN ISNULL(NestedSelect.Sum, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(NestedSelect.Sum, 0) - ISNULL(InvoiceAccountsBalance.SumBalance, 0) >= NestedSelect.Sum THEN 5 WHEN ISNULL(NestedSelect.Sum, 0) < 0 AND ISNULL(NestedSelect.Sum, 0) - ISNULL(InvoiceAccountsBalance.SumBalance, 0) <= NestedSelect.Sum THEN 5 ELSE CASE WHEN ISNULL(NestedSelect.Sum, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(NestedSelect.Sum, 0) - ISNULL(InvoiceAccountsBalance.SumBalance, 0) > 0 THEN 3 WHEN ISNULL(NestedSelect.Sum, 0) < 0 AND ISNULL(NestedSelect.Sum, 0) - ISNULL(InvoiceAccountsBalance.SumBalance, 0) < 0 THEN 3 ELSE 1 END END ELSE 0 END
